name: Moth-Trapping Fire
descriptionTemplate: Gain [Block:Arg1] Shield, put 1 {Exhaust} {Green Flames} into hand. {Leap}: Before the start of next turn, each time you are attacked, put 1 {Exhaust} {Green Flames} into hand.
lore:
Moths lack brains and act purely on instinct.
Since that's the case, let's show these brainless fools what they desire.
It's the dream of a young girl, brimming with innocence and wonder.
